answer: The prism schedule is applied in fable and reef makes public each instalment. Anyone hence cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 9 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 927 identities would post 1135 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
